title: Knowledge Digester adapter: web, themes and design systems
requested_outcome: Context: the Knowledge Digester (docs/product-memory/KNOWLEDGE_DIGESTER_V1.md on the trunk; SOURCE_ASSIMILATION_V1.md) turns any external artifact into provenance-tagged, reversible Units. Its model is in app/digest/model.py in this base commit (Unit with artifact_id, kind from UNIT_KINDS, title, body of at most MAX_BODY characters, a Location of path and line span, and tags). This objective adds one adapter, the stage that decomposes a quarantined artifact into Units. Adapter contract, shared by every adapter: a module in app/digest/adapters/ (a namespace package: do not create app/digest/adapters/__init__.py, sibling objectives add their own adapters there) exposing NAME (a short string), HANDLES (a tuple of plain-word artifact kinds it understands) and decompose(root: Path, artifact_id: str) -> list[Unit], which reads only (never executes, imports or installs anything it reads), bounds file sizes and counts, returns Units in a deterministic order with exact locations, and never raises on malformed input (it skips what it cannot parse and says so in a Unit of kind knowledge tagged 'unparsed' with the reason). Standard library only. Build app/digest/adapters/design.py for web front ends, Shopify themes and design systems. CSS custom properties, tokens.json and design-token files, and Tailwind configuration objects (read as text, never evaluated) become design_token Units grouped as colour, typography, spacing, radius, shadow and motion. Shopify themes: each section and snippet becomes a pattern Unit with its schema (the {% schema %} JSON) as an interface Unit, and config/settings_schema.json becomes interface Units. Web apps: each HTML page becomes a pattern Unit describing its structure (landmarks, headings, forms, components by class naming) without its scripts; component files (.jsx, .tsx, .vue, .svelte) become pattern Units with their props where readable. Tests in tests/test_digest_adapter_design.py build fixtures in tmp_path covering every case named here, prove determinism, bounded sizes and that malformed input yields an 'unparsed' Unit rather than an exception. You cannot run commands: the loop runs the listed checks after you report and returns any failure output, and the independent review returns its findings, to your next attempt. Do not report an owner decision for GitHub acceptance: it runs automatically after your candidate is published.
acceptance_criteria: design tokens, theme sections and schemas, and page and component patterns are extracted
the adapter follows the shared contract: read-only, bounded, deterministic, never raising on malformed input
